reason: Session auto-commit is explicitly identified as unsafe for universal default adoption. Automatically committing agent-produced changes without human review removes a critical safety checkpoint. This prototype must not be distributed as a default hook and must remain in .staging/ if retained as research evidence only.
safety_concerns: Commits agent-produced changes to the repository without human review or explicit opt-in per session.
A compromised or misbehaving agent could commit malicious or privacy-violating content automatically.
Failure of the commit step (e.g., merge conflict, protected branch) leaves the repository in an undefined state with no recovery documentation.
Auto-commit combined with session-logger creates a permanent record of potentially private session content.
adoption_blocked_by: Explicitly ruled out as a default by issue 015 non-goals.
Privacy risk when combined with session content that includes prompts or environment data.
No tests or JSON payload fixtures.
